statements.t: “We also recently aligned with the FDA on our non-IPF ILD-related chronic cough program and expect to initiate a Phase 2 dose-ranging trial in the first quarter of 2027.
The Company expects to initiate the trial in the first quarter of 2027, subject to review of the trial protocol by the FDA, and topline results are expected in the first half of 2028.
Based on our projected product labeling, the Company believes this patent will be listable on the Orange Book for the non-IPF ILD-related chronic cough indication.
Based on projected enrollment, the Company now expects to report the outcome of the SSRE analysis early in the first quarter of 2027.
The Company continues to expect topline results from the full trial in the second half of 2027.

The Company expects its current cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities will provide cash runway into 2030 and fund the development of Haduvio for the treatment of patients with IPF-related chronic cough, through potential FDA approval.

The Company also expects these cash resources will enable the Company to fund the clinical development program through Phase 2 for the treatment of patients with non-IPF ILD-related chronic cough, and the ongoing Phase 2b LAKE trial for the treatment of patients with RCC.
The Company plans to hold a conference call and webcast to discuss the Company’s financial results and business highlights.
